in_hebrew.name: Garcon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Garcon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Garcon is derived from the Old French word ‘garcon’, which means ‘young boy’, ‘page’, or ‘servant boy’. This name has been in use for centuries and is popular in French-speaking countries. It is often given to boys as a sign of respect and appreciation, reflecting the importance of youth and service in society.
